# CORE-DAT-01

**Is every significant data set named with an owner and a classification?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | DAT: Data |
| Default severity | major |

## Rule

The schema enforces owner and classification; a reviewer checks no significant data set is missing.
